providers.name: Google AI Studio
providers.models: 8 Gemini / Gemma variants incl. Gemini 2.5 Flash (1M context)
providers.catch: Free-tier prompts may train models unless you opt out (EU/UK/EEA accounts are exempt by default); the biggest models get the strictest daily caps.
steps: Go to aistudio.google.com and sign in with any Google account — no billing setup.
Click Get API key → Create API key, copy the key.
Point any OpenAI SDK at base URL generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/openai with the key.
Start with gemini-2.5-flash: ~15 RPM and 1,500 requests/day free, 1M-token context.

providers.name: Groq
providers.models: Llama 3.3 70B, Mixtral, Gemma, Whisper — fastest inference (~320 tok/s)
providers.catch: Limits vary slightly per model tier; the free tier is for development and light production, not bulk processing.
steps: Sign up at console.groq.com (email or GitHub login, no card).
API Keys → Create API Key → copy it.
Use base URL https://api.groq.com/openai/v1 with any OpenAI SDK.
Try llama-3.3-70b-versatile — huge quality-per-free-request ratio.

providers.name: OpenRouter
providers.quota: 50 requests/day free; 1,000/day after a one-time $10 top-up
providers.catch: The $10 top-up (kept as credit, never consumed by :free models) is what unlocks the practical 1,000/day tier — pure-free accounts get 50/day.
steps: Create an account at openrouter.ai — no card needed.
Keys → Create Key → copy.
Base URL https://openrouter.ai/api/v1, then call any model id ending in :free.
If you need more than 50 req/day, top up $10 once — the credit stays yours.

providers.name: Mistral
providers.catch: Experiment tier requires opting into data training; detach from it (paid tier) for sensitive workloads.
steps: Sign up at console.mistral.ai — no card required.
Accept the Experiment-tier terms (that is what unlocks the free quota).
API Keys → Create a new key → copy.
Base URL https://api.mistral.ai/v1 works with OpenAI SDKs.

providers.name: Cerebras
providers.models: Llama 3.3 70B, Qwen, gpt-oss — extreme speed (1,000+ tok/s)
providers.catch: Daily token cap is the binding limit, not request count — long prompts eat it fast.
steps: Register at cloud.cerebras.ai (no card).
Create an API key from the dashboard.
Base URL https://api.cerebras.ai/v1 — OpenAI SDK compatible.
Best free tier for latency-critical chat UX.

providers.name: Cloudflare Workers AI
providers.catch: Neurons are Cloudflare's compute unit — a 70B-model request costs far more neurons than a small model.
steps: Create a free Cloudflare account.
Dashboard → AI → Workers AI → grab your Account ID from the URL.
Create an API token with Workers AI permission.
Use the OpenAI-compat endpoint with your account id in the path.

providers.name: GitHub Models
providers.models: GPT-4o/4.1, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Llama, Phi, DeepSeek — frontier names for free
providers.catch: For prototyping only (GitHub's own terms); low rate limits per model, and it is not meant for production traffic.
steps: Sign in to GitHub → github.com/marketplace/models.
Pick a model → Playground → Get this model's endpoint.
Generate a Personal Access Token with models scope.
Use the endpoint with OpenAI SDK, token as API key.

providers.name: NVIDIA NIM
providers.catch: Free credits refresh as promotional 1,000-request batches; enterprise-grade models rotate.
steps: Sign up at build.nvidia.com with email (no card).
Any model card → Get API Key → copy.
Base URL https://integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1.
Good for testing Nemotron and fresh Llama builds early.

providers.name: Cohere
providers.catch: Trial keys are non-commercial only — production needs a paid key.
steps: Register at dashboard.cohere.com.
Trial API key is issued automatically on first login.
Use the Cohere SDK or REST endpoint.
Command R+ is the free tier aimed at RAG with citations.

providers.name: Hugging Face
providers.quota: Small monthly free credits across providers
providers.catch: Free credits are tiny and provider-dependent; expect this as a sampler, not a workhorse.
steps: Create a free huggingface.co account.
Settings → Access Tokens → create a fine-grained token.
Call router.huggingface.co/v1 (OpenAI-compatible) with Bearer token.
Browse model cards for the exact provider routing ids.

providers.name: Chutes
providers.catch: Community-run capacity: uptime and availability of specific models are best-effort.
steps: Sign up at chutes.ai.
Generate an API key from the dashboard.
Base URL https://api.chutes.ai — OpenAI SDK works.
Check the live catalog before pinning a model id.

providers.name: Vercel AI Gateway
providers.models: Multi-provider (BYOK): OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, open models
providers.quota: BYOK — your own provider keys/quotas apply
providers.catch: Not a free quota itself — it unifies and routes the free tiers you already have.
steps: Create a Vercel account → AI Gateway section.
Add your provider API keys (Groq, Google, etc.) as BYOK credentials.
Call the gateway endpoint with one unified SDK.
Route across free tiers with a single base URL.

trial_credits.name: Baseten
trial_credits.note: Card required after credit runs out

trial_credits.name: DeepSeek
trial_credits.note: Try R1-class reasoning for free; paid pricing is among the cheapest anyway
